name: biblioteca-v2
description: Sistema de gestión de biblioteca Full Stack con React, Express y PostgreSQL

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npx prisma generate
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.prisma:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
